published_by: Ofgem (Default Tariff Cap, Annex 2 wholesale cost allowance methodology)
what_this_is: The default tariff cap's Unidentified Gas (UIG) uplift on the gas direct fuel cost, per cap period, non-prepayment and prepayment, read off Ofgem's Annex 2 model tab '3a Allowances' rows 31 (Gas non-PPM) and 38 (Gas PPM), the row 'Values to be used to update level of default tariff cap'. A fraction: the direct fuel cost is multiplied by (1 + uplift).

basis.measures: The ALLOWANCE, not the outturn. Until Sep 2025: the AUGE's forecast domestic UIG (EUC 1ND/1PD, Profile Classes 3 and 4) over forecast consumption. From Oct 2025: Xoserve's post-reconciliation UIG averaged over two gas years, reallocated to domestic classes (Ofgem, Call for input: Enduring Unidentified Gas Allowance, Aug 2025, para 1.4, 1.9, 3.1). Ofgem found the forecast basis under-recovered: post-reconciliation domestic UIG averaged 2.90% over gas years 2022-23 and 2023-24.
basis.ppm: Before April 2022 the model carries one gas row (its PPM row is empty); `ppm` is null there and a reader takes the non-PPM figure.
basis.quarterly_columns: From Oct 2022 the model carries one column per quarter; the two columns of each six-month period Oct 2022 - Sep 2023 carry identical values and are carried here once.
basis.pre_cap: No allowance existed before 2019-01-01. A reader needing a pre-cap value carries its own stated belief (simulation/policy_costs.get_gas_uig_uplift); nothing here supplies one.
basis.history_check: Two earlier editions were read for the same rows: v1.3 (Feb 2019) gives 0.02 for gas; v1.9 (Feb 2022) gives 0.0182 non-PPM and 0.0534 PPM for Apr-Sep 2022. Both agree with v1.30.

source_check.publication: Ofgem, Annex 2 - wholesale cost allowance methodology, v1.30 (published with the October - December 2026 cap)
source_check.derived: 2026-10-27, by reading the workbook's '3a Allowances' tab rows 8, 31 and 38 by column (W2_36). The workbook itself is not committed.
source_check.how_to_recheck: GET the URL above (a version history page, not the workbook) and take the highest v<major>.<minor> across every link matching Annex[-_ ]2 or wholesale[-_ ]cost[-_ ]allowance[-_ ]methodology. If it is above `version_token`, re-read rows 31 and 38 of '3a Allowances'.

checked_for_supersession.note: v1.30 was the newest Annex 2 listed on the page on 2026-10-27, published with the Oct-Dec 2026 cap.
